extracted.intended_audience: authors and report-writers of randomised trials; trialists, journal editors, peer reviewers, and methodologists
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and checklist for complete, transparent reporting of randomized (clinical) trials across the whole manuscript, with many extensions for specific designs, outcomes, and interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2025 Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guideline for reporting randomised trials; intended to improve completeness and transparency of trial reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2025 provides a checklist for reporting randomized trials (downloadable from CONSORT-SPIRIT website). The entry references simultaneous publications of the guideline in multiple journals (BMJ, JAMA, Lancet, Nat Med, PLoS Med). Applies to whole report. See also explanation and elaboration paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2025 Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: The checklist associated with the CONSORT 2025 Statement for reporting randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available for download from the CONSORT-SPIRIT website; intended to be used when preparing trial reports to ensure all recommended items are reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2025 explanation and elaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation and elaboration paper accompanying CONSORT 2025 that provides detailed rationale and examples for checklist items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published alongside the main statement (BMJ e081124) to clarify how items should be reported, with examples and further detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Harms (2022)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension focused on the reporting of harms (adverse events) in randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides recommendations, explanation and elaboration to improve how harms are reported in trial reports (BMJ 2023 reference).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Non-inferiority
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting of noninferiority and equivalence randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines reporting standards specific to noninferiority/equivalence designs (JAMA 2012 reference).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Cluster
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension to CONSORT for reporting cluster randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adaptation of CONSORT 2010 checklist to the specifics of cluster designs (BMJ 2012 reference).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Herbal
rubrics_metrics.description: Elaborated CONSORT statement for reporting randomized, controlled trials of herbal interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers additional guidance tailored to herbal interventions (Ann Intern Med. 2006).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Non-pharmacological treatment interventions (NPT)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for randomized trials of nonpharmacologic treatments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated guidance including an extension for abstracts of nonpharmacologic interventions (Ann Intern Med. 2017).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT for Abstracts
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting randomized controlled trials in journal and conference abstracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which items should be reported in abstracts of trial reports to improve transparency and usefulness (PLoS Med. 2008; Lancet 2008).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Pragmatic Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension of CONSORT for improving reporting of pragmatic randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses reporting elements important for pragmatic trial design and interpretation (BMJ 2008).

rubrics_metrics.name: STRICTA (acupuncture trials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for Reporting Interventions in Clinical Trials of Acupuncture; an extension of CONSORT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides specific intervention reporting items for acupuncture trials to enable replication and interpretation (PLoS Med. 2010).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT PRO
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting patient-reported outcomes (PROs) in randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives guidance on reporting PROs to ensure validity, interpretation, and transparency (JAMA 2013).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-CENT (N-of-1 trials)
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting N‑of‑1 trials (CENT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist and elaboration to improve reporting of single-patient crossover trials (BMJ 2015).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT application to orthodontic trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on applying and adapting the CONSORT Statement within orthodontic trial reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses application and adaptations to the CONSORT statement for the orthodontic literature (Am J Orthod Dentofacial Orthop. 2015).

rubrics_metrics.name: TIDieR
rubrics_metrics.description: Template for Intervention Description and Replication: checklist and guide for better reporting of interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to complement CONSORT by ensuring interventions are described in sufficient detail for replication (BMJ 2014).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT extensions for Simulation Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guidelines for health care simulation research: extensions to CONSORT and STROBE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides tailored reporting items for simulation-based research to improve transparency and reproducibility (Simul Healthc. 2016).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT extension for pilot and feasibility trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension checklist for reporting randomized pilot and feasibility trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies reporting items relevant to pilot/feasibility studies distinct from definitive trials (Pilot and Feasibility Stud. 2016).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-CHM formulas (2017)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting N‑of‑1 trials for Chinese Herbal Medicine formulas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations, explanation and elaboration tailored to Chinese herbal medicine formulas (Ann Intern Med. 2017).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT for within-person randomised trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension checklist for trials where participants receive more than one intervention in different body parts/times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adapts CONSORT items for within-person trial designs (BMJ 2017).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-Equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension and elaboration for better reporting of health equity in randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides items to improve reporting on equity-related considerations and subgroup analyses (BMJ 2017).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-SPI
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for reporting randomized trials of social and psychological interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailors reporting recommendations for the particularities of social and psychological intervention trials (Trials. 2018).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT extension for stepped wedge cluster randomised trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting stepped wedge cluster randomized trial designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a checklist and elaboration for stepped wedge designs to ensure appropriate reporting of design, analysis, and timing (BMJ 2018).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT for multi-arm parallel-group randomized trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting randomized trials with more than two arms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies considerations and reporting items when multiple intervention arms are compared (JAMA 2019).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2010 extension to randomised crossover trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension checklist for randomized crossover trial reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adaptation of CONSORT 2010 to the specifics of crossover designs (BMJ 2019).

rubrics_metrics.name: CENT for TCM
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT extension for N‑of‑1 trials for traditional Chinese medicine (CENT for TCM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations and elaboration for reporting N‑of‑1 trials in TCM contexts (Complement Ther Med. 2019).

rubrics_metrics.name: STRICTOC (cupping)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for reporting interventions in clinical trials of cupping; extension of CONSORT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides intervention reporting items specific to cupping trials (Chin Med. 2020).

rubrics_metrics.name: ACE Statement (Adaptive designs CONSORT extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist and elaboration guideline for reporting randomized trials that use adaptive designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses reporting of adaptive features, adaptations, and related statistical considerations (BMJ 2020).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-AI
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guidelines for clinical trial reports for interventions involving artificial intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension addressing AI-specific intervention reporting (BMJ 2020; Nat Med. 2020; Lancet Digital Health. 2020 references).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-ROUTINE
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting randomized controlled trials conducted using cohorts and routinely collected data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist and elaboration for trials leveraging cohort or routinely collected data sources (BMJ 2021).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-Outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for reporting outcomes in trial reports: CONSORT-Outcomes extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies how outcomes should be reported to improve clarity and comparability (JAMA 2022).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-DEFINE (Dose-finding Extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance to enhance reporting quality and impact of early phase dose-finding clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist and elaboration for early phase dose-finding trials (BMJ 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT Factorial
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting factorial randomized trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses reporting elements unique to factorial trial designs (JAMA 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-Surrogate
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting of surrogate endpoints in randomized controlled trial reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides checklist items for transparent reporting and interpretation of surrogate endpoints (BMJ 2024).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT-iNeurostim
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guidelines for randomized controlled trial reports of implantable neurostimulation devices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailors CONSORT items to neurostimulation device trials (EClinicalMedicine 2024).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT CRXO (cluster randomised crossover trials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension for reporting cluster randomised crossover trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checklist and elaboration specific to cluster randomised crossover designs (BMJ 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT: Scope – applies to the whole report
rubrics_metrics.description: The CONSORT guidance is intended to apply to the whole trial report, not just parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should use the CONSORT checklist to inform reporting across the entire manuscript (title/abstract/introduction/methods/results/discussion).

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT Statement (protocol development guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for developing protocols for clinical trials (SPIRIT 2013).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended for authors preparing trial protocols; complementary to CONSORT for reporting protocols versus final reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting guidelines for main study types (catalogue entries)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of other main reporting guideline families for different study designs (STROBE, PRISMA, SPIRIT, STARD, TRIPOD, CARE, AGREE, RIGHT, SRQR, COREQ, ARRIVE, SQUIRE, CHEERS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page situates CONSORT within a broader library of reporting guidelines; users are directed to specific guidelines depending on study type (observational, systematic review, diagnostic, prognostic, case reports, guidelines, qualitative, animal, quality improvement, economic evaluations).

rubrics_metrics.name: STROBE
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for observational studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as the main guideline family for observational study reporting (with extensions).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catalogued under reporting guidelines for systematic reviews (with extensions).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-P
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for systematic review protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under study protocols guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: STARD
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for diagnostic/prognostic studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as the main guideline for diagnostic accuracy and prognostic study reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: TRIPOD
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for prediction model studies (diagnostic/prognostic).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in the catalogue of reporting guidelines for diagnostic/prognostic studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: CARE
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for case reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catalogued under case reports guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: AGREE / RIGHT
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for reporting clinical practice guidelines (AGREE and RIGHT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under clinical practice guideline reporting guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: SRQR / COREQ
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guidelines for qualitative research (SRQR, COREQ).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included under qualitative research reporting guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: ARRIVE
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for animal pre-clinical studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under animal research reporting guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: SQUIRE
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for quality improvement studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included under quality improvement study reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: CHEERS
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guideline for economic evaluations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catalogued under economic evaluations reporting guidance.
